description: This file defines a function that generates a dropdown list of external API modules related to Documents in a SuiteCRM environment. It includes a conditional check for security, documentation about licensing, and a single function that interfaces with an external factory class to retrieve API options.

methods.name: getDocumentsExternalApiDropDown
methods.description: Generates an array of external API options for Document modules, merging default options with those fetched via ExternalAPIFactory, and including a specific 'Sugar' option.
